tools.name: nanobanana_generate_image
tools.description:
Generate an image using Gemini's native image generation (Nano Banana).

This tool calls the Gemini API to generate an image based on your text prompt and saves it to the specified path.

**Models**:
- gemini-2.5-flash-image: Fast, efficient (~$0.039/image)
- gemini-3-pro-image-preview: Higher quality, supports 4K (~$0.134-0.24/image)

**Supported Aspect Ratios**: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4

**Example**:
```
prompt: "A modern flat illustration of a workflow diagram with three connected nodes, purple and blue gradient colors, minimal style"
output_path: "assets/generated/workflow-hero.png"
model: "gemini-2.5-flash-image"
aspect_ratio: "16:9"
```

prompt.description: Image generation prompt describing the desired image

output_path.description: Relative or absolute path to save the generated image (e.g., 'assets/generated/hero.png')

model.description: Gemini model to use. Flash for speed, Pro for quality

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

overwrite.description: If true, overwrite existing file. If false, skip if file exists

tools.name: nanobanana_list_queue
tools.description:
List and validate prompt files in the queue directory.

This tool scans the queue directory for markdown prompt files and provides:
- Validation status for each file
- Conflict detection (output file already exists)
- Preview of prompt content

Use this to review what will be generated before running process_queue.

**Example**:
```
queue_dir: "nanobanana/queue"
validate: true
check_conflicts: true
```

queue_dir.description: Directory to scan for prompt files

validate.description: If true, validate each prompt file and report errors

check_conflicts.description: If true, check if output files already exist

tools.name: nanobanana_process_queue
tools.description:
Process all prompt files in the queue directory and generate images.

**Modes**:
- `validate_only=true`: Only validate prompts, no API calls
- `dry_run=true`: Show what would be generated, no API calls
- Both false: Actually generate images

**Overwrite Strategies**:
- `skip`: Skip if output file exists (default)
- `overwrite`: Replace existing files
- `rename`: Generate with suffix (e.g., hero_1.png)

After successful generation, prompt files are moved to completed_dir with timestamp.

**Example**:
```
queue_dir: "nanobanana/queue"
dry_run: true
overwrite: "skip"
```

output_dir.description: Default directory to save generated images (used if prompt has relative path)

completed_dir.description: Directory to move processed prompts to

model.description: Gemini model to use for all generations (overrides prompt settings)

validate_only.description: If true, only validate prompt files without generating images

dry_run.description: If true, show what would be generated without actually calling API

overwrite.description: Strategy when output file exists: skip, overwrite, or rename with suffix
